sloka: रावणस्य च बाणौघैरामविस्फारितेन च।शब्देन राक्षसास्ते च पेतुश्च शतशस्तदा ।। ६.१००.१६ ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇasya ca bāṇaughairāmavisphāritena ca।śabdena rākṣasāste ca petuśca śataśastadā ।। 6.100.16 ।।

translations.english: Then by Ravana's shafts and Sri Rama's stretching of the bow and sound of twang, Rakshasas fell in hundreds.
